arguments.question: Open question (no predetermined root cause): Given that terminal reach succeeded (reach_passed=true, handle f6be7b6a22b85; terminal_error_m=0.007642608585867386, handle f43a69b8c4da2, within reach_tolerance_m=0.01, handle f9e0cdc61f6d7) yet sampled secondary settling failed (sampled_settling_passed=false, handle fd03a5c6cee0f) against settling criteria position_limit_m=0.01 (handle f614ca2ba852e), speed_limit_m_s=0.02 (handle f01b97ab32ab4) over window_s=0.05 (handle f6382c260ba25), why did the tip not settle inside the window despite the small terminal position error? Recorded context: terminal_speed_m_s=0.6351726092425104 (handle f81b1dbe1d67b) still exceeds the settling speed limit; late_max_error_m=0.05813810428573256 (handle ff47840769a24) and late_max_speed_m_s=1.5810152739742807 (handle f141a00f08e6f) are the recorded late-window extremes; deadline_misses=35 (handle f3e59cefcd307) with mean_update_s=17.075238151415917 s (handle f5e0c39558a9c) against control_period_s=0.01 s (handle fd49845c3b95b), stopping_counts User_Requested_Stop=34 (handle f43420decaa95) and Solve_Succeeded=1 (handle f569f5a2f1f35), configured horizon=10 (handle f775debbc81c6), and prediction-dominated weighting (tracking_weight=1.0 vs velocity_weight/terminal_velocity_weight=0.0001, terminal_weight=5.0, holding_tip_speed_weight=0.0 and terminal_tip_speed_weight=0.0). Which competing mechanisms best explain the failed settling: slow terminal approach not being braked within the short window (e.g. weak tip-speed/braking weighting relative to position tracking), per-update plan selection / selected-iteration and effective-horizon behavior across the 35 updates, repeated deadline misses inflating update latency, or residual backend-model mismatch between the one-step prediction and the measured backend motion? I ask for a bounded comparison of these candidates, not a dominant-cause verdict.
scope: Retained-evidence reads (no solve, no evaluation): source.summary already handed over; may read source.backend_motion via the derived motion view over sample_times_s [0.01, 0.35] focusing on the final settling window, and the endpoint_query view over selected controller updates (at most 8 update_ids per query) for measured backend position/velocity at matched next timestamps.

Retained-evidence reads of source.one_step_predictions (35 records, /{update_id}/one_step_prediction), source.saved_projected_states (/{update_id}/measured_initial_state), source.plan_selection (/{update_id}/optimization_selected_iteration), source.solver_status (/{update_id}/optimization_raw_status), source.controller_horizon (/{update_id}/effective_horizon), and source.applied_tensions (/{update_id}/actual_tension_n) to compare recorded endpoints, plan selection, solver status, and effective horizon across updates.

Explicitly authorized saved-state numerical work only within the host protocol grant: prediction_braking and local_comparison on the saved projected state, model.gvs@1.0.0, implicit_euler, horizon_s=0.01, integration_step_s=0.002, max_checks=1, max_wall_s=300, numerical_limits local_solves=6 and prediction_evaluations=24, configuration_scope=saved_state_or_temporary_analysis.

Excluded: any production controller parameter change, any backend/simulation execution or closed-loop replay, any causal-attribution claim. source.historical_full_plans (control_snapshots.json) is declared not_retained in inventory, and full_snapshots_available=false (handle f49c66d9bb5e4), so optimizer iteration traces and full warm plans are out of scope.

Coverage note: this context has received only the explicit common-summary handoff (59 handles); all other inventory entries are queried-but-not-yet-read here, so any absence statement will be scoped to the unread subset as not_displayed.
stopping_conditions: Stop when retained-evidence reads plus at most the authorized saved-state checks have either bounded or eliminated each listed candidate mechanism, or when the numerical grant (local_solves=6, prediction_evaluations=24) or phase tool-call/model-call budget is exhausted.

Stop if the available checks cannot separate objective weighting from plan selection / horizon effects or from backend-model mismatch when they predict the same endpoint, and report that as a coverage limitation rather than a cause.
Stop if further reads would only re-confirm the same recorded values with no new discriminating evidence, and deliver the report with explicit not_displayed / queried coverage declarations.
Stop after the advertised evidence-turn allowance ends, delivering the current phase with its remaining handoff tool.
